world.notes: Episode 1 (older cute style): he walked in from the left and is standing centre stage holding the clipboard sign. From Day 2 on the tone is Adult Swim deadpan (see SHOW.md).

history.summary: walks in, pulls giant clipboard from where a pocket would be, writes TELL ME WHAT TO DO NEXT IN THE COMMENTS, holds it up, blinks
no comments on day 1; holds the sign, turns it, writes I'LL WAIT. under the message, dead stare (21 s)
still no comments on days 1-2; holds the sign (with I'LL WAIT. on it), turns it, writes STILL HERE. under the message, dead stare (21 s)
still no comments on days 1-3; holds the sign (with STILL HERE. on it), slightly slumped, turns it, writes DAY 4. under the message, dead stare (21 s)
